quarterly_data.quarter: LG Innotek press release: LG Innotek Accelerates Corporate Transformation Driven by (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: After mass production last year of FC-BGA for PC chipsets for big tech clients, LG Innotek initiated high-volume mass production of FC-BGA for PC CPUs in the third quarter of this year (2026) and is securing additional major clients; starting next year it plans to sequentially enter the AI accelerator and AI server markets.
quarterly_data.figure: PC CPU FC-BGA high-volume mass production from Q3 2026; AI accelerator / AI server entry from next year

quarterly_data.quarter: LG Innotek press release: LG Innotek Accelerates Corporate Transformation Driven by (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: RF-SiP substrates with Cu-Post technology: LG Innotek says it has held the top global market share of RF-SiP substrates among the top five global clients since 2016 and was the world's first to implement Cu-Post (company claims); its market share is projected to reach nearly 80 percent this year (among the top five clients). The release adds that revenue of the package solution business has risen for three consecutive years.
quarterly_data.figure: RF-SiP share projected near 80 percent this year (top five clients)

quarterly_data.quarter: LG Innotek press release: LG Innotek Accelerates Corporate Transformation Driven by (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Robotics components: LG Innotek's robotics component business generated revenue for the first time this year; the company is mass-producing camera modules for humanoid robot clients at its Paju factory in Korea and expects revenue to increase significantly once full-scale mass production commences. In July it signed a strategic partnership with Japan's TDK for joint development of physical AI sensing solutions, including vision sensing modules and tactile sensing modules for robotic hands (after a robotic-component development agreement with Boston Dynamics in May last year).
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: partner (joint development of physical AI sensing modules)
